title: Aerodynamic Design and CFD
metaDescription: How Aaryan Lath applies aerodynamics and CFD: Ahmed body vehicle simulations and slant-angle drag sweeps in AAE 412, plus graduate AAE 514 aerodynamics.
hero: Aerodynamics is the thread running through Aaryan's coursework at Purdue: he has simulated vehicle aerodynamics in CFD, swept geometry to study its effect on drag and downforce, and carried graduate aerodynamics coursework as an undergraduate.

evidence.context: AAE 412: Computational Fluid Dynamics, an advanced CFD course in Purdue's School of Aeronautics and Astronautics.
evidence.whatIDid: Simulated the aerodynamic performance of a car using an Ahmed body approximation, sweeping slant angles to study their effect on drag, downforce, and overall vehicle behavior, then wrote up the methodology and results in a course report.
evidence.outcome: The full report is available from the Academia section of this site via OneDrive.

evidence.context: Graduate-level aerodynamics coursework taken as an undergraduate in Purdue's aerospace engineering program.
evidence.whatIDid: Completed AAE 514 Intermediate Aerodynamics alongside AAE 550 Multidisciplinary Design Optimization, deliberately loading graduate courses on top of the standard aerospace curriculum while serving as a teaching assistant for AAE 251.
evidence.outcome: Carried a 3.73 GPA and Dean's List standing every semester through that load.
